name: Restocking the Larders

angles.text: As a cook, gathering strider meat and small eggs gives you practical experience and recipes suited to Zephras wildlife.

faq.answer: The local cook needs three Small Eggs and eight cuts of Strider Meat to feed the village while danger keeps ordinary foragers indoors.
faq.q: What supplies are needed for Restocking the Larders?

faq.answer: Wild creatures throughout the Shen'dar Highlands on Zephras provide the strider meat and small eggs.
faq.q: Where can the ingredients be found?

faq.answer: Rising dangers make it too perilous for ordinary villagers to hunt or forage, leaving the food stores depleted.
faq.q: Why is the village running low on food?

faq.answer: The cook offers culinary tips, techniques, and training in local recipes in exchange for fresh provisions.
faq.q: What reward does the cook offer for the food?

faq.answer: The Shen'dar Highlands lie on Zephras, where locals face mounting threats while trying to sustain their daily lives.
faq.q: What are the Shen'dar Highlands and Zephras?

faq.answer: The cook fries freshly gathered small eggs in ursera tallow, a comfort on Zephras.
faq.q: How does the cook prepare the eggs?

sections.body: Rising dangers make life harder in the Shen'dar Highlands. Villagers can no longer safely enter the wilderness to forage or hunt, and the communal stores are nearly empty. So local cooks rely on travelers willing to brave the wild trails and help keep the settlement fed.
sections.title: Dangers in the Highlands

sections.body: The cook asks you to find strider meat and fresh small eggs among the highlands' wildlife. In return, the cook shares knowledge of local game and its recipes. Small eggs fried in ursera tallow offer comfort, with dried peacebloom for a quiet pipe.
sections.title: Sustenance and Comfort

summary: In the Shen'dar Highlands of Zephras, a village cook needs help keeping the food stores full. Danger keeps the villagers from foraging, so the cook turns to you for eggs and strider meat.
attribution: In-game quest text: Restocking the Larders
